confirmed_software_mechanism: Public DTD is driven by pre-AEC mic/reference energy evidence while far-end is active.
Across pinned real pure-far corpora, case-level public-DTD occupancy strongly covaries with pre-AEC mic/reference energy ratio.
The false-DTD behavior reproduces across Interspeech2021 and ICASSP2022 pinned real corpora, so it is not isolated to one recording or one corpus.
High mic/reference disparity is already present in source-domain recordings before pipeline boundary resampling, Sync fractional interpolation, or the mic-only 80-Hz HPF.
Boundary resampling, Sync selection/interpolation, HPF, single-delay route ambiguity, and multipath coherence modulate observations but do not explain the dominant cross-case false-DTD variation.
Source-domain render-coherent and complementary incoherent-excess energy both covary with the broader source mic/render level disparity; neither component alone identifies the cause.

key_evidence.finding: public-DTD false positives are widespread; DTD strongly tracks mic/reference energy ratio
123/125 cases show nonzero public DTD; median DTD about 63.8%; ratio association reproduces strongly
interpolation energy effect is small and does not explain false-DTD variation
high ratio exists before HPF; HPF usually slightly reduces mic energy
source-domain relative level disparity dominates; resampler and Sync are small modulators
total source mic/render ratio associates with DTD more strongly than coherence itself; coherent and excess components both covary with total disparity

remaining_unknowns: The pinned public datasets do not expose sufficient per-GUID device/room/gain-chain metadata to identify whether source-domain disparity is caused by device playback/capture gain, acoustic echo-path gain, room/multipath behavior, upstream DSP, noise, nonlinearity, or a mixture.
No frame-accurate physical near-end ground truth exists for the pure-far recordings because the evaluated scenarios are far-end-only by construction.
The accumulated evidence does not establish a safe gain normalization, replacement DTD feature, or new threshold.
closure_reason: The candidate-zero diagnostic program has reached a discriminative plateau on the currently pinned public data: repeated transforms of the same anonymous recordings no longer separate the unresolved physical contributors. Additional same-corpus probes are not authorized merely to refine attribution.
next_authorized_data_need: Obtain independently labeled or metadata-rich measurements that expose playback/capture gain, device/room identity, calibrated render/mic levels, or controlled echo-path conditions; alternatively, obtain explicit governance authorization and a new source-candidate budget before proposing algorithm changes.
prohibited_actions: derive or apply gain normalization from these diagnostics
change Activity DTD thresholds or hangover
change HPF, Sync, resampler, AEC, RES, NS, AGC, or VAD source based on this closure
open a source candidate without explicit new candidate-budget authorization
promote this evidence to HIL, Product Certification, release, or shipping authority
continue result-dependent same-corpus probe proliferation without a new discriminative data source
